label: OpenRouter
description: AI language model completion through OpenRouter. The credential decision comes from a wired OpenRouterAccess node (Credits or your own key); model, system prompt, and sampling parameters come from a wired OpenRouterConfig node, and without one the defaults apply (default model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6).

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The prompt to send to the LLM

inputs.name: history
inputs.description: The conversation so far (a ChatHistoryAppend chain or a previous call's history output). The prompt is appended as the newest user message.

inputs.name: media
inputs.description: Media attached to this prompt: one stored image, audio clip, or video, or a list of them.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The OpenRouter access (wire an OpenRouterAccess node's output): whose key the call spends.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Optional OpenRouterConfig node carrying ALL settings (model, system prompt, parameters, key). Unwired, the defaults apply.

inputs.name: parseJson
inputs.label: Parse JSON
inputs.description: Parse and repair JSON from the response (changes output to Dict).

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: LLM response. Declare type in Weft: String without parseJson, or Dict/JsonDict with parseJson. With parseJson, you can also add custom output ports to extract specific JSON keys directly.

outputs.name: history
outputs.description: The conversation including this call: the input history plus the new user message and the assistant reply. Wire it onward to continue the conversation.
